definition.def: Activity is a situation in which a lot of things are happening or being done.
examples: ...an extraordinary level of activity in the government bonds market.
...the electrical activity of the brain. [+ of]

definition.def: An activity is something that you spend time doing.
examples: You can take part in activities from canoeing to bird watching.

definition.def: The activities of a group are the things that they do in order to achieve their aims.
examples: He had also been imprisoned for his political activities.
On April 29, the activities of the company were suspended.
